## Why This Is Asked

This question probes practical, beginner-friendly processes for securing CI/CD pipelines and protecting the software supply chain in real-world workflows for small teams.

## Key Concepts

- Secrets management in CI/CD
- SBOM and supply-chain hygiene
- Artifact signing and verification
- Log redaction and secret scanning

## Code Example

```yaml
name: Secure Build
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build application
        run: ./build.sh
      - name: Generate SBOM
        uses: anchore/sbom-action@v0
      - name: Sign artifact
        run: echo ${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEY }} | gpg --import
      - name: Verify no secrets in logs
        run: |
          ./build.sh 2>&1 | grep -i secret && exit 1 || echo "Logs clean"
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```javascript
// Node.js example: verify HMAC signature per tenant
const crypto = require('crypto');
function verifyTenantWebhook(tenantId, payload, signature, getSecret){
  const secret = getSecret(tenantId); // fetch from HSM-backed store
  const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(hmac, 'hex'), Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'));
}
```

- How would you handle cross-tenant revocation latency?
